basic_info.description: Situated on a corner lot just one block from Ocean Beach, this well-maintained 4-unit building presents a rare opportunity for both investors and owner-occupiers. The property features four large 1-bedroom, 1-bath units, with two units currently vacantideal for immediate rental income or owner move-in.    Each sunlit unit boasts a bright living room, kitchen with dining area, and a spacious bedroom with a full bath down the hall. Additional amenities include coin-operated laundry and off-street parking for 3 cars  a rare find in this beachside community.    Located in the Outer Sunset, the property offers easy access to an array of neighborhood favorites, including Gus's Community Market, Outerlands, Andytown Roasters, Devil's Teeth Baking Company, Hook Fish Co., and the vibrant Irving Corridor. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Golden Gate Park and Ocean Beach, perfect for weekend strolls or surf sessions. Commuting is a breeze with Lincoln Blvd, Great Highway, and the N-Judah Muni line all nearby, providing convenient access across the city and beyond.
